title: Dropout Neural Network Training Viewed from a Percolation Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2512.13853v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work, we investigate the existence and effect of percolation in training deep Neural Networks (NNs) with dropout. Dropout methods are regularisation techniques for training NNs, first introduced by G. Hinton et al. (2012). These methods temporarily remove connections in the NN, randomly at each stage of training, and update the remaining subnetwork with Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). The process of removing connections from a network at random is similar to percolation, a paradigm model of statistical physics.   If dropout were to remove enough connections such that there is no path between the input and output of the NN, then the NN could not make predictions informed by the data. We study new percolation models that mimic dropout in NNs and characterise the relationship between network topology and this path problem. translated_title: 从渗流视角看Dropout神经网络训练
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究了在使用dropout训练深度神经网络（NNs）过程中渗流现象的存在性及其影响。Dropout方法是训练神经网络的正则化技术，最早由G. Hinton等人于2012年提出。这些方法在训练的每个阶段随机地暂时移除神经网络中的连接，并使用随机梯度下降（SGD）更新剩余的子网络。从网络中随机移除连接的过程类似于渗流——统计物理学中的一个范式模型。如果dropout移除了足够多的连接，使得神经网络的输入与输出之间不存在路径，那么神经网络就无法做出基于数据的预测。我们研究了模拟神经网络中dropout的新型渗流模型，并刻画了网络拓扑与这一路径问题之间的关系。该理论证明了dropout中存在渗流效应。我们还表明这种渗流效应……
tldr: 该论文将统计物理学中的渗流理论引入dropout神经网络训练的研究，建立了模拟dropout的新型渗流模型，证明了dropout中存在渗流效应，并刻画了网络拓扑结构与输入输出路径问题之间的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces percolation theory from statistical physics into the study of dropout neural network training, developing new percolation models that mimic dropout, demonstrating the existence of a percolative effect in dropout, and characterizing the relationship between network topology and the input-output path problem.
